list: The official 55 PS5 trophies as published on PlayStation, taken from Exophase and cross-checked with PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements (Planet GTA 6, 18 Nov 2026). Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them; every guide below is written in our own words for this guide.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum. It pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is nothing extra to do for it, so work through this guide's roadmap in order and it will be the last trophy you earn. All 55 trophies are single-player and offline, so no online play is ever needed.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, automatic. Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 and it unlocks when the mission ends. You cannot miss it: it is tied to finishing the mission, not to how you play it.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, automatic. It unlocks when Chapter 1 ends — PowerPyx notes it pops after completing the first main mission of Chapter 2, 'What's in the Bag?'. Just keep playing the story; there is no optional objective attached to it.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, automatic. It unlocks when Chapter 2 ends, after the first main mission of Chapter 3, 'Welcome to Vice City'. Nothing to do but play the story through.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, automatic. It unlocks when Chapter 3 ends — after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, 'Ocean Beach' and 'Another Life'. Story progress only.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, automatic. It unlocks when Chapter 4 ends, after the final main mission of Chapter 4, 'Starting From Zero'. Keep playing the story and it comes to you.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The gold story trophy. Finish the final mission of the story and it unlocks with the ending. Because there is no mission replay in GTA VI, keep a manual save at the start of the final stretch, as PowerPyx advises — the game has 15 manual save slots plus one autosave, so sparing one is cheap insurance.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, automatic. It unlocks during Chapter 2, when you complete the main mission 'Breakfast Run'. Just play the mission; it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, automatic. It unlocks during Chapter 3, when you complete the main mission 'The Cartel Heist'. Story progress only — no side objective.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, automatic. It unlocks during Chapter 4, when you complete the main mission 'Child's Play'. Just play the mission through.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, automatic. It unlocks during Chapter 4, when you complete the main mission 'Headliners'. Story progress only.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, automatic. It unlocks during Chapter 4, when you complete the main mission 'VCIA Takedown'. Just play the mission through.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, automatic. It unlocks during Chapter 5, when you complete the main mission 'Operation Savage Glory'. Story progress only.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The gold for 100% completion — PowerPyx calls it the hardest trophy, and the one the platinum really turns on. The checklist unlocks after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but progress you make during the story already counts. It is lenient: PowerPyx puts it at roughly 60% of true completion, needing only part of most totals (200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 70 of 80 challenges, 100 optional missions) — but all robberies, all shooting ranges, all drone races, all 15 Target Decks and all 39 gang operations are required in full. Nothing on the checklist is missable, and it can all be finished in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida. PowerPyx breaks them down as 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps, and notes you can mix categories — under-the-bridges runs are the quickest. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250. Track them under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. The game counts them under Touchpad > Progress > Activities. You will meet most of them through the story and the other trophies, so this usually pops on its own while you work through the list.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, across 12 shooting range locations. PowerPyx links a full location guide; the ranges are also needed in full for the 100% checklist. Gold medals here are not hard, per PowerPyx — take your time, use a steady weapon, and redo any challenge you miss; the ranges stay open after the story.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations (42 drone races in total). Any win at a location counts — you do not need to win every race at each spot. Drone races are also a full requirement of the 100% checklist, so this folds into the cleanup stage.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races, out of 40 unique race locations. Each distinct race you win counts once, so work through new locations rather than repeating one you like. Races also feed the activity count for Master of None.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission 'Feng Shui', where you meet Cal, he will text you and mark a fishing spot with a purple icon on the map. Follow his fishing questline from there — the challenge itself is the trophy.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game (called 'Video Games' in-game). There are four: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You must finish all levels of one game at least once — beating every challenge inside it is not required — so pick whichever you enjoy most.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's optional questline; the trophy pops on its last mission. The line is marked automatically in Chapter 3 and is Lucia-only: while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville. Five quests: 'Climbing the Cellerichain' (parts 1-3), 'Pay the Cellerica Fee', 'Peach!', 'Read the Label' and 'Puff Puff Pass'. All of it stays available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's optional questline; the trophy pops on its last mission. It is marked automatically in Chapter 1: after the mission 'Island Dreams' (work for Kenton), he calls you and is marked with a green 'KR' icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — purple chest icons on the map — using a metal detector on the ocean floor. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees. Kenton goes away for a while after Chapter 1 but comes back in Chapters 2-3, so nothing here is missable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's optional questline; the trophy pops on its last mission. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break', at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Five quests: 'Thrillbillies', 'Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab', 'Mall Rats', 'The Impaler' and 'Hometown Heroes'. All stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only certain questlines count — PowerPyx confirms Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete among them, and notes that lines like Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this trophy. Check your count in the trophy tracker itself. All strangers stay available in free-roam after the story, so do them whenever.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.chapter: Chapter 3 — after Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's optional questline ('Randy's Wish List'); the trophy pops on its last mission. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS', where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City (green 'RK' icon) — scan cars with the WAiNK app to check them against his list, steal them, and drive them back in good condition for better pay. Cars he marks appear in fixed spots; the rest you can steal off the street. All available after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's optional questline; the trophy pops on its last mission. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission 'Here, Kitty Kitty' and is Jason-only. Purple markers point to Synthetic Labs in Vice City — go and destroy them as part of 'Take Out Kitty Litter'. Once enough labs are down, Tyrone gives the second quest, 'Spin On This', which unlocks the trophy. All available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: The only trophy PowerPyx and GTABase flag as possibly missable: a Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house is gone after Chapter 1. Do it in Chapter 1.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 spots in 10 locations, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts double. Track them under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. THE ONE POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY: PowerPyx and GTABase both flag it. In Chapter 1, after the mission 'Down to Earth', Lucia may suggest meditating in the morning at Jason's house — follow her to the balcony and accept. That meditation adds +1 to the counter but is not marked as a spot, and it is gone after Chapter 1; PowerPyx says it is still unconfirmed whether it is required, and its author had done it when the trophy popped. Do it in Chapter 1 to be safe. The final meditation needs both characters together, unlocked after Chapter 2's 'Coffee Break'. For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 are needed.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret (Bret Vogel). His line is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break': while playing as Jason you get a text marking his first quest, 'Veteran Hunted', in Lummox County — Lucia cannot receive it, so this is Jason-only. He then marks hunting spots with purple icons; hunt the animals he requests and bring them back. His first quest gives you the unique hunting rifle 'Killtelligence SM-69', retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation. One clean shot keeps the animal pristine and pays more, but is not required. All available after the story. PowerPyx notes it is still being confirmed exactly which animal pops the trophy — the questline itself is the way in.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 card sets in the world; any 3 finished sets count. Cards are a collectible type — work through them with a map guide (PowerPyx links all 18 set locations) and the trophy pops on the third completed set.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. Hold up on the D-pad and R1 to scan objects in the world — landmarks (31), curiosities (35), sculptures (23) and No Flusher tags add up to far more than 100, so any 100 will do. Scan as you travel and this pops naturally; it also feeds the vehicle scanning needed for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges. Track them under Progress > Challenges. Most complete naturally while you chase the other trophies; the 100% checklist wants any 70 of 80, so this pops on the way there. Save the awkward ones for last and pick the easiest of what remains.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Earliest chance is after Chapter 2's 'Coffee Break', when you can roam with Jason and Lucia together (call your partner with right on the D-pad + Triangle). Build 4 stars by causing chaos, then escape the red heat zone in a fast bike — PowerPyx suggests the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where the helicopter cannot follow. It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' and while robbing the 8 large bank vaults, which always trigger 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Only after 'Coffee Break' (Chapter 2), when you can play with your partner. Hit 3 robbery targets (green icons) while the police chase stays active — keep the flashing wanted level, do not let it drop or spike into the red heat level. Wear armor, carry sticky bombs and healing items, and loot properly in each shop (a couple of items plus the back-room safe). The trophy pops about half a minute after leaving the third shop — if it does not, hit a fourth. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after Chapter 3's 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs'.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The fastest way is the WAiNK app: hold up on the D-pad, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. Just stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive them. Leonida has 557 vehicles at launch, and the 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this pops long before you finish that.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming; it slows time and highlights weak spots, draining the purple focus bar. Buff focus first (food, drinks, washing up at home), take Adrenaline to stretch the window, wear body armor, and use an accurate full-auto weapon like the Duke 556. Line up 5 enemies at a gang operation and drop them fast. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots; by the time you have done the other trophies you will likely be at level 4 and this comes naturally.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal — it must be connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not one parked on the airfield. Easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, take the stairs by the boarding bridge straight into the plane, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the airstrip and take off. Fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank — a Rhino. They stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate (or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb in, and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Chapter 3's 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs' — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and marks jewelry store robberies (green icons) on the map. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun instead of kicking it (which trips the alarm), find the note with the safe code in the back room, and loot the safe. PowerPyx suggests Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.chapter: Chapter 4 — after That's Where The Money Is…
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe)' — it teaches the method: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a second bag. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 a tip for security van locations (after his earlier Payday Loans jobs). Each vault robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch cars to go unrecognized. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist wants all 8, so this pops on the way.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.chapter: Chapter 4 — after That's Where The Money Is…
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The same Chapter 4 mission, 'That's Where The Money Is…', counts: tailing the armored truck to the bank and robbing the vault counts as robbing the truck. Or do it earlier — block an armored truck driving near banks in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open (sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests). Either way the trophy only pops after you escape the red heat radius.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every blacked-out patch until the whole map is visible. Do it late, once you have a plane and have already travelled most of the state for other trophies, and it is a short job.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 gang operations in total, marked with yellow icons when you go near them; you only need one per gang for this trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 39. Track progress under Progress > Gangs — each gang's page shows how many of its operations you have robbed.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. HONEST STATUS: no guide has pinned this one down yet — PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown (checked 19 Nov 2026). The description is the only solid fact: a cocktail, with a view, on Ocean Beach. Likely a specific bar or spot on the beachfront; check this guide's sources for updates before you go hunting, and do not trust any method that cites no source.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. HONEST STATUS: no guide has pinned this one down yet — PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown (checked 19 Nov 2026). The description points at a showroom smash-out, in the style of the classic GTA openings; the exact showroom and trigger are still unconfirmed. Check the linked guides for updates rather than following an uncited method.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun 'Gutterball Moreland 850' on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office (blow it with sticky bombs — buy them at Ammu-Nation first). You first go there in the Chapter 2 optional mission 'Hit Kingpin Bowling'. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item — and you do not need all 3 in one visit: the robbery icon respawns, so you can come back for what you missed.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal: get maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Only after Chapter 2's 'Coffee Break', when you can switch between them. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon). Work out at fitness clubs — buy a membership, always go together (call your partner with right on the D-pad + Triangle), and while one trains the other completes their training automatically, so you progress twice as fast. You can also work out at home after the story. Filter for fitness clubs on the map under Activities.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) and a little demon face appears whenever an action counts. The profile runs from Professional (stealthy jobs, clean escapes) through Hardened and Violent to Psycho and Irredeemable — the last is permanent, so avoid endless rampages. Most of the 500 will happen passively while you rob and fight through the other trophies; if you are short at the end, the count is tracked by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. (GTABase via CryptoGames; PowerPyx lists the same 500 figure.)

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. HONEST STATUS: no guide has pinned this one down yet — PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, with an unconfirmed lead that it relates to the Payday Loans store from the prologue (checked 19 Nov 2026). The description suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something. Until a guide confirms it with evidence, treat the Payday Loans lead as a rumor, not a method — check the linked guides for updates.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? HONEST STATUS: no guide has pinned this one down yet — PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, with an unconfirmed lead pointing at a UFO questline (checked 19 Nov 2026). The description suggests witnessing something strange. Do not chase an uncited UFO method; check the linked guides for updates as players confirm the trigger.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. HONEST STATUS: no guide has pinned this one down yet — PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, with an unconfirmed lead that it involves kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle (checked 19 Nov 2026). If the lead is right, the method is a melee attack from a moving bike; until a guide confirms it, treat that as a rumor. Check the linked guides for updates.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. First finish Chapter 3's 'Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew)' to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans, and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 counts across all robberies, not in one trip, and bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery. It comes naturally while you do the robberies for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the priciest, so they are the fastest route; clothing, footwear, hair and electronics all count too. The total is cumulative across the whole game, so this pops naturally if you buy gear as you play — if you are short at the end, spend the difference on car mods or weapons.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties (4 more garages come from the story and do not count). Garages open for purchase after Chapter 2's 'Daily Driver' mission, when the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone; buy them through the app. They cost $160,000 in total. Robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4, are the quickest way to fund them.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives on your phone after Chapter 2's 'Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses)' mission. You need parking first — each garage you own adds spots, so buy garages (see Little Boxes) before you start. Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose 'Respray' then 'Register'; at first he only takes vehicles without trackers, and from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
